sloka: जले तरुण सूर्याभैः षट्पद आहत केसरैः ।पन्कजैः शोभते पम्पा समन्तात् अभिसंवृता ॥४-१-६४॥
transliteration: jale taruṇa sūryābhaiḥ ṣaṭpada āhata kesaraiḥ ।pankajaiḥ śobhate pampā samantāt abhisaṁvṛtā ॥4-1-64॥

translations.english: 'Frequented by the Chakravakas and surrounded by the wonderful forest with thirsty elephants and deer this Pampa looks beautiful.
